instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: My sister is a wonderful musician.
In order to solve a mystery, you need to start following clues.
atoms.b: In order to solve a ((mystery)), you need to start following clues.

atoms.a: Some people say that a phantom lives in that house.
atoms.b: Some people say that a ((phantom)) lives in that house.

atoms.a: Tim and Farrah discussed the environmental movement during their forest run.
atoms.b: Tim and Farrah discussed the environmental ((movement)) during their forest run.

atoms.a: I went to a wilderness camp this summer and slept in a tent for two months!
atoms.b: I went to a ((wilderness)) camp this summer and slept in a tent for two months!

atoms.a: Leo’s family lived in Japan for three years, so he has some knowledge of Japanese.
atoms.b: Leo’s family lived in Japan for three years, so he has some ((knowledge)) of Japanese.
